title: 第19章 摸小手第20章澄明之心
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
等白露眼神狐疑的看过去。
蔺兰舟这才猛然惊觉，自己好像应允的太过于干脆了……
他立马垂下眼眸，避开白露的视线。
同时迅速定了定神，敛去脸上多余的神色。
恢复了平常那样冷漠疏离的模样。
随后他故作自然地小幅度地挥了挥淡蓝色的云袖，这才稍有些不自在的说道：“你莫要多想……”
“我们浮云剑宗的剑修向来信守承诺……”
“何况你我之间已立下了天地誓言。”
如今，你已将这菩提心寻来。”
“故而我应当遵守承诺，与你定下婚约。”
蔺兰舟这番话说的义正辞严。
顿时将白露心中刚刚升起的那点疑虑打消了大半。
也是。
剑修这群人在灵界中可是出了名的认死理和信守承诺。
看来是自己多虑了。
眼看对方这会都不看一眼，自己刚刚稍推过去的菩提心。
这倒是让急于邀功的白露心中掠过了一丝微微的失望。
他怎么不看呀？
自己都费了这么大的功夫，千里迢迢将这菩提心从那灵界中带回。
并且还带回了两个小尾巴。

怎么到现在把东西都放在他眼前了。
他怎么能视若无睹呢?
这样想着，白露又悄咪咪地从那浅蓝色、泛着流光的宽大衣袖底下。
伸出了两只素白如玉、指尖透着淡淡粉嫩的纤纤玉手。
准备将那莲花琉璃盏再往前推一推。
结果这时的蔺兰舟也正好伸手想要将那莲花琉璃盏捧起来。
这一前一后。
却正好让蔺兰舟将那骨节分明，并且手指修长的大掌，将此时白露伸过来的两双手盖在了上面。
这突然间的肌肤触碰。
却顿时让其中一人立马僵在了原地。
至于白露，虽然也诧异了一瞬。
但下一秒，心中便美滋滋地冒起了泡泡：哎呀！看来今天运气真不错。
竟然摸到了灵界第一美男的小手！
嘿嘿嘿……
她那那清冽的凤眼不由得微微一弯。
不过这灵界第一美男的手中好多茧子啊。
怎么完全不是自己想象中的那样嫩滑。
白鹿在心中暗自腹诽道。
还是说剑修的手都是这样？
粗粗糙糙的。
content_en:
Wait for Bai Lu to look over with suspicious eyes.
Lin Lanzhou suddenly realized that he seemed to have agreed too simply...
He immediately lowered his eyes and avoided Bai Lu's gaze.
At the same time, he quickly calmed down and wiped away the unnecessary look on his face.
He returned to his usual cold and distant appearance.
Then he waved his light blue cloud sleeves in a small way, pretending to be natural, and then said slightly uncomfortably: "Don't think too much..."
"Our sword cultivators from the Fuyun Sword Sect have always kept their promises..."
"Besides, you and I have made an oath between heaven and earth."
Now, you have found this bodhicitta. "
“Therefore I should keep my promise and make a marriage contract with you. "
Lin Lanzhou's words were righteous.
Most of the doubts that had just arisen in Bai Lu's heart were instantly dispelled.
Yes.
Sword cultivators are famous in the spiritual world for accepting death and keeping their promises.
It seems that I am worrying too much.
Seeing that the other person didn't even look at him for a moment, he just pushed past the Bodhicitta.
This actually made Bai Lu, who was eager to take credit, feel slightly disappointed.
Why doesn't he look?
I have spent so much effort and traveled thousands of miles to bring this bodhicitta back from the spiritual world.
And he also brought back two little tails.
Why are you putting everything in front of his eyes now?
How could he turn a blind eye?
Thinking like this, white dew quietly slipped out from under the light blue, shiny and wide sleeves.
He stretched out two slender jade hands that were as white as jade, with fingertips showing a light pink color.
Prepare to push the lotus glazed lamp forward again.
As a result, at this moment, Lin Lanzhou reached out and wanted to pick up the lotus glass cup.
This one goes one after the other.
But just in time for Lin Lanzhou to cover the two hands that Bai Lu stretched out with his big palms with clear joints and slender fingers.
This sudden skin contact.
But it immediately caused one of them to freeze in place.
As for Bai Lu, she was surprised for a moment.
But the next second, bubbles bubbled up happily in my heart: Oops! It seems like you are very lucky today.
He actually touched the little hand of the most beautiful man in the spiritual world!
Hey hey hey...
Her clear phoenix eyes couldn't help but bend slightly.
But the most beautiful man in the spiritual world has a lot of calluses on his hands.
Why is it not as tender and smooth as I imagined?
Bai Lu cursed secretly in his heart.
Or are all sword cultivators’ hands like this?
Rough and rough.
